req.title: Update pre-populates form
req.statement: The system shall pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the update form should be pre-filled with the existing post's title and body. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_update_form_prefill_positive
expected: Form pre-filled with title 'test title' and body 'test\nbody'
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as 'test' user
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Access the update form for post id 1
r = client.get('/1/update')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'test title' in r.data
assert b'test\nbody' in r.data

tests.name: test_update_form_prefill_negative
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Attempt to access the update form without logging in
r = client.get('/1/update')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert '/auth/login' in r.headers['Location']

tests.name: test_update_form_prefill_boundary_empty_post
preconditions: Post with id 2 exists and has empty title and body
expected: Form pre-filled with empty title and body
tests.executable:
